prompt: Generate one PRODUCTION TEXTURE SOURCE SHEET for an original desktop isometric zombie survival game called Dead Woods. Exactly two separate square tiles laid out horizontally side-by-side against a clean solid magenta background with a deep margin. Both same dimensions, precise symmetrical layout and clean thin frames. Left tile: charcoal-brown scuffed field canvas stretched over a very thin chipped dark iron rim, subtle tan thread stitch just inside the rim, very dark nearly uniform middle with a tiny rough woven texture. Right tile: raised worn charcoal iron button with fine scuffs, cold slate highlight along top and left, dark bottom and right, compact dark center. Extremely restrained texture, texture goes all the way across the central area without any gradient, no center ornament. The assets will be reduced to 96x96 and used for NineSlice, thus every decorative edge must fit inside outermost ~10 percent, straight sides with consistent repeatable coloring, no internal corners except in each tile's real corners. Crisp low-res pixel art, brown blacks, warm dull brown, desaturated grey blue. No numbers or painted words. Fill the canvas with the two large swatches side by side.
